channel.description: Recent content in Self-Hosted on ExitCode0

item.title: How to Give Claude Code a Real Browser: Headful Chromium in Docker with Playwright MCP
item.description: Run a headful Chromium in Docker on your dev VM so Claude Code can browse, shop and screenshot sites with no laptop on, and watch it over VNC from a phone.

item.title: How I Turned My Laptop Into a Dumb Terminal With a Tailscale Dev VM, T3 Code, and Claude Code
item.description: A persistent dev VM over Tailscale running T3 Code and Claude Code turns any laptop into a thin client, and why I'm stripping Windows down instead of upgrading.

item.title: Running Ollama in a Proxmox LXC with NVIDIA GPU Passthrough
item.description: Set up Ollama in a Proxmox LXC with NVIDIA GPU passthrough, Tailscale access and Open WebUI. Run local LLMs with GPU acceleration on your own hardware.

item.title: Automating Postgres Deployment with Docker Compose and Init Scripts
item.description: Deploy PostgreSQL with Docker Compose and an init script that creates databases and users automatically. Portable, isolated Postgres with Compose V2 and Bash.

item.title: Running Uptime Kuma With Docker Compose
item.description: Deploy Uptime Kuma website and API monitoring with Docker Compose. Self-hosted uptime tracker and status page for infrastructure monitoring in a home lab.

item.title: Writing to an InfluxDB server with Python3
item.description: Write time-series data to InfluxDB from Python 3 for Grafana visualisation. Store sensor readings with nanosecond timestamps using the influxdb-client library.

item.title: Setup the Nextcloud Snap Package with HTTPS and a separate data path
item.description: Install the Nextcloud snap on Ubuntu with Let's Encrypt HTTPS and a separate data mount on an external drive, with automatic certificate renewal.

item.title: Backup Nextcloud with RCLONE
item.description: Back up a self-hosted Nextcloud instance to UNRAID NAS using Rclone WebDAV integration. Automated encrypted cloud-to-local sync with selective folder targeting.

item.title: Backup Google Photos with Rclone
item.description: Back up Google Photos to a local NAS or computer with Rclone. Automated offline copy of your entire photo library with WebDAV sync and scheduled cron jobs.
